work.author: GREGORIUS PP. XVI.
work.description: Letter CXXIV (address LF27645–27647 to Ignatius Peter, Syrian patriarch of Antioch) thanks him for news of returning schismatics and the adoption of the Gregorian calendar and mourns the apostolic delegate; LF27693 → LF27699 across own provenance LF27696; complete 14 January 1837 closing. Refined body and full surrounding frame read literally. Issuer evidence is GREGORIUS PP. XVI. at LF27650–27650; the source closing at LF27710–27713 reads: Datum Romae apud sanctum Petrum: sub annulo piscatoris die decima quarta ianuarii millesimo octingentesimo trigesimo septimo, pontificatus Nostri anno sexto. Exact source extent and surrounding boundaries were inspected as uncorrected OCR; no complete print-image collation or historical authentication is claimed.
